days.title: Glacial Waters and Central Crossings
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Bierikjávrre
stops.detail: One of the most beautiful glacier lakes in Sarek is the Bierikjávrre.

stops.name: Skarja
stops.detail: In the park there are no accommodations, no marked paths and only four bridges, e.g. in the center of the park at Skarja over the Smájllájåhkå and over the glacial river Guhkesvákkjåhkå.

days.title: Rapa Valley Views and History
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Låddebákte
stops.detail: A rewarding viewpoint over the Rapaädno is located on the Låddebákte (about two days' march from Aktse).

stops.name: Rovdjurstorg
stops.detail: In the Rapaselet is also the so-called Rovdjurstorg (Predator Square), so named because traces of all four predators living in Sarek were found here one morning: bear, wolverine, lynx and arctic fox.
